newsitem.title: USA: FINOVA to sell finance unit to Green Tree.
newsitem.headline: FINOVA to sell finance unit to Green Tree.

text.p: FINOVA Group Inc said on Monday it had entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Manufacturer and Dealer Services unit to Green Tree Financial Corp for about $610 million.
FINOVA said it decided to sell the unit as part of its move to concentrate on its core commercial finance activities.
The unit is a provider of vendor-oriented sales finance programs involving small-ticket leasing and financing products for commercial end-user customers.
The deal, subject to regulatory approval and closing conditions, is set to close by November 30.
FINOVA said the move will free up equity that can be invested in its more traditional businesses.

It said the deal will not have any meaningful impact on earnings. It said part of the sale proceeds will be used to reduce goodwill that resulted from FINOVA's acquisition of TriCon Capital Corp in 1994.
